name: Distance from the Sun
question: Average distance from the Sun in astronomical units (1 AU is Earth's distance). Each gridline step is ten times farther.

items.name: Mercury
items.fact: A year on Mercury lasts 88 Earth days.

items.name: Venus
items.fact: A day on Venus is longer than its year.

items.name: Earth
items.fact: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes 20 seconds to reach Earth.

items.name: Mars
items.fact: Mars is named after the Roman god of war.

items.name: Ceres
items.fact: Ceres was called a planet for about 50 years after its discovery in 1801.

items.name: Jupiter
items.fact: Jupiter takes almost 12 years to orbit the Sun.

items.name: Halley's Comet (average)
items.fact: Halley's Comet returns about every 76 years; next in 2061.

items.name: Uranus
items.fact: Uranus was the first planet found with a telescope, in 1781.

items.name: Neptune
items.fact: Neptune was found by mathematics before anyone saw it.

items.name: Pluto
items.fact: Pluto hasn't completed an orbit since it was discovered in 1930.

items.name: Haumea
items.fact: Haumea spins so fast it's shaped like an egg.

items.name: Makemake
items.fact: Makemake is named after a creator god of Easter Island.

items.name: Eris
items.fact: Eris is almost exactly the same size as Pluto.

items.name: Sedna
items.fact: One orbit of Sedna takes over 11,000 years.
